ledgers.expected: The September 2019 PEP 602 is Draft/Informational, proposing annual releases starting with Python 3.9; it is not accepted policy at this cutoff.

The proposal is annual feature releases in October, with next-version work beginning at Beta 1. Development phase details have a real conflict: heading says 17 months, prose 16, phases 5+7+4+1 sum 17; preserve the unresolved discrepancy.
Draft proposes one year of monthly bugfix releases and four years of as-needed source-only security releases, five years total; these are proposed terms, not accepted commitments.
